queries: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The qualifying condition is that a single lab record has both `U-PRO` = '-' and RA = '-' (exact string match), but the averages are computed over all of that patient's lab records, not just the qualifying ones.
Ties in average HCT are left in arbitrary order since the request gives no tie-breaker.
